notes: Guests Test2 leaves out of its runs for now (testvm/test2/README.md, Holds; t2lib/plan.py Planner.held_why). Every stic, holt (any variant) and guest cell that boots a held guest is not runnable in every word, a word that names the cell included, whatever the specs (guest/spec.json, holt/spec.json, stic/manifests.json, classes.json) say: so a stop rule never sees its FAILs and a loop that reruns FAILs by name doesn't bring it back.
